content: Akaabanne Wordancho Nabeta
Sooreynne Isra7eeley oletonna heedzu laythi saro de7idosona.
Heedzantho laythan, Yihuda kawoy Iyosaafexi Isra7eele kawa be7anaw bis.
Isra7eele kawoy ba moorinnatako, “Galadan de7iya Raamota katamay nubaa gideysanne nuuni hanno gakanaw he katamaa Soore kawuwape ekanaw aykoka oothonaysa ereketii?” yaagis.

I, Iyosaafexa, “Galadan de7iya Raamota katamaa olanaw taara baanee?” yaagidi oychis. Iyosaafexi zaaridi, “Ee, neeni olaa baanaw giigiya wode ta neera baana. Ta olanchoti ne olanchota; ta parati ne parata” yaagis.
Qassi, Iyosaafexi Isra7eele kawa, “Gidoshin, sinthatada Godaa oycha” yaagis.
Isra7eele kawoy oyddu xeetu nabeta issife shiishidi, “Galadan de7iya Raamota katama olanaw booye boopo” yaagidi oychis. Enti, “Ba; Goday he katamaa kawa kushen aathidi immana” yaagidosona.
Shin Iyosaafexi, “Nuuni Godaa oychanaw danda7iya hara nabey haysan baawee?” yaagis.

Isra7eele kawoy zaaridi, “Nuuni iya baggara Godaa oychanaw danda7iya issi addey de7ees. I, Yimila na7aa Mikiyaasa. Shin I ubba wode tabaa iitabaape attishin, lo77oba odonna gisho ta iya ixayis.” Iyosaafexi, “Kawoy hessa goopo!” yaagis.
Hessa gisho, Isra7eele kawoy ba moorinatape issuwa xeegidi, “Yimila na7aa Mikiyaasa elle ekada ya” yaagis.

Isra7eele kawoynne Yihuda kawoy Iyosaafexi banta kawotetha ma7uwa ma7idi, Samaare katamaa geliya pengiya matan de7iya wudumman banta kawotetha araatan uttidosona; nabeti ubbay enta sinthan tinbite odoosona.
Entafe issoy, Kanaane na7ay Sedeqiyaasi birata kaceta giigisidi, “Goday haysada yaagees; ‘Sooreti dhayana gakanaw ne enta ha kacetan qaycana’ ” yaagis.
Hara nabeti ubbay, “Galadan de7iya Raamota katamaa bada ola; xoona. Goday he katamaa, kawa kushen aathidi immana” yaagidi odidosona.
Mikiyaasa xeeganaw kiitetidi bida addey, “Heko, nabeti ubbay issi doona gididi, ‘Kawoy ha olaa xoonana’ yaagidi odidosona. Hessa gisho, hayyana ne odayka entaysa mela gido; ne lo77oba oda” yaagis.
Shin Mikiyaasi, “Goday eriya mela, Goday taw odiyaba ta odana” yaagis.

Mikiyaasi kawako yida wode, kawoy, “Mikiyaasa, nu Galadan de7iya Raamota katamaa olanaw biino boopo” yaagidi oychis. Mikiyaasi, “Bada ola; ne xoonana. Goday he katama kawa kushen aathidi immana” yaagis.
Kawoy, “Ne Godaa sunthan taw tuma odana mela ta nena aapun toho caaqetho?” yaagis.
Mikiyaasi, “Isra7eele olanchoti ubbay henthanchoy bayna dorsada deriya bolla laaletidaysa ta be7as. Goday, ‘Haysatas godi baawa. Enti ubbay banta soo soo saro boo’ ” yaagis.
Isra7eele kawoy Iyosaafexako, “I tabaa iitabaa odeesipe attishin, lo77oba odi erenna gada, ta new odabikina?” yaagis.
Mikiyaasi gujidi, “Hiza Goday giyaba si7a! Goday ba araatan uttin, salo kiitanchoti ubbay iya ushachaninne haddirsan eqidashin be7as.
Goday, ‘Akaabi Galadan de7iya Raamota katamaa bidi, yan hayqana mela balethanay oonee?’ yaagis. Issoy haysada giya wode hankoy qassi hessada gees.
Wursethan issi ayyaani keyidi Godaa sinthan eqidi, ‘Ta iya balethana’ ” yaagis.
Goday, “Ne waata balethanee?” yaagis. Ayyaanay, “Ta bada, iya nabeta ubbaa doonan wordo ayyaana gidana” yaagis. Goday, “Ne iya balethana; new hessi hanana. Bada baletha” yaagis.
Mikiyaasi gujidika, “Heko, Goday ne bolla dhayo ehanaw qachida gisho ne nabeta ubbaa doonan wordo ayyaana wothis” yaagis.
Hessafe guye, Kenaana na7ay Sedeqiyaasi shiiqidi, Mikiyaasa baqidi, “Godaa Ayyaanay tana aggidi waanidi new odanaw bidee?” yaagis.
Mikiyaasi, “Heko, neeni qosetanaw qol7a geliya gallas hessa demmana” yaagis.
Isra7eele kawoy ba olanchotape issuwa, “Mikiyaasa oykada katama haariya Amoonesinne ta na7aa Iyo7aasas efada imma.
Kawoy simmana gakanaw ha addiya qasho keethan wothite. Taani saro simmana gakanaw, guutha uythafenne haathaafe haraba aykoka iyaw immopite” yaagis.
Mikiyaasi, “Tuma ne saro simmiyaba gidiko, Goday taw odibeenna” yaagis. Qassika, Mikiyaasi, “Asa ubbay ta odidaysa akeekite” yaagis.
Akaaba Hayquwa
Hessafe guye, Isra7eele kawoynne Yihuda kawoy Iyosaafexi Galadan de7iya Raamota katamaa bidosona.
Isra7eele kawoy Iyosaafexi, “Ta ma7uwa laammada, hara asi daanada olaa gelana; shin neeni ne kawo ma7uwa ma7a” yaagis. Isra7eele kawoy ma7uwa laammidi, hara asi daanidi olaa gelis.
Soore kawoy ba para gaareta kiittiya hastamanne nam7u asatako, “Kawa xalaali attishin, hara ooderaka oletofite” yaagidi kiittis.
Para gaariya kiitteysati Iyosaafexa be7ida wode, “Tuma haysi Isra7eele kawa” yaagidosona. Iyara oletanaw simmin Iyosaafexi waassis.
Para gaareta kiitteysati, I Isra7eele kawa gidonnaysa be7idi, iya yedetheysa aggaagidosona.

Gidoshin, issi addey coo ba dongiya bolla dukidi, Isra7eele kawa olaa ma7oy gahetiya bessaara caddin, Isra7eele kawoy ba gaariya laagiya addiyako, “Gaariya guye zaarada, tana olaa giddofe kessa; taani iita cache cadetas” yaagis.
He gallas olay goobiya wode, Isra7eele kawoy Akaabi ba para gaariya giddon zempidi, Sooreta sinthan takis. Iya suuthay para gaariya giddo gukin, I omarsi hayqis.
Away wullanaw matishin, “Asa ubbay ba katamaa katamaa boo! Asa ubbay ba biitta biitta boo!” giya kiiti si7etis.
Enti kawa Samaare katamaa efidi yan moogidosona.
Layma maccasati meecetiya, teqetidi uttida Samaare haathan gaariya meeccidosona. Goday kase odida qaalada iya suuthaa kanati laacidosona.
Akaabi hanida harabay, I oothidaba ubbay, dangarsa zaalen kawo gadho keexidabaanne gimbida katamatabay ubbay Isra7eele kawota Taarike Maxaafan xaafetis.
Akaabi hayqidi ba mayzatan gahetis; iya bessan iya na7ay Akaziyaasi kawotis.
Yihuda Kawa Iyosaafexa
Isra7eele kawoy Akaabi kawotida oyddantho laythan Asa na7ay Iyosaafexi Yihudan kawotis.
I kawotiya wode laythi iyaw hastamanne ichasha; I Yerusalaamen laatamanne ichashu laythi kawotis. Iya aayiya Shiliha na7iw Azuubo.

Iyosaafexi ba aawa Asa ogiyan hemetis; I he ogiyape gede haa gibeenna; Godaa sinthan suureba oothis. Gidoshin, dhoqa goyinno bessata dhaysibeenna; asay he bessan yarshonne ixaane cuyisethi aggibeenna.
Iyosaafexi Isra7eele kawuwara sigetis.
Iyosaafexi hanida harabay, iya minotethaynne I oletida olay Yihuda kawota Taarike Maxaafan xaafetis.
Iya aaway Asi kawotida wodiyape doomin, attida addera addera laymateyisata biittafe diggis.
He wode Edoome biittan kawoy baawa; he biittan shuumetida halaqi haaris.
Ofira biittafe worqa ehana mela Iyosaafexi gita markabeta oosisis; shin he markabeti Exiyoon-Gabiran meqeretidosonape attishin, kumthi bibookona.
He wode Akaaba na7ay Akaziyaasi, “Ta oosanchoti ne oosanchotara issife markabiyan boo” yaagis; shin Iyosaafexi ixis.
Iyosaafexi hayqidi ba mayzatan gahetis. Ba mayza Dawita Kataman moogetis. Iya bessan iya na7ay Iyoraami kawotis.
Isra7eele Kawa Akaziyaasa
Yihuda kawoy Iyosaafexi kawotida tammanne laapuntho laythan, Akaaba na7ay Akaziyaasi Isra7eele bolla Samaaren kawotis; Isra7eele bolla nam7u laythi kawotis.
Akaziyaasi Godaa sinthan iitabaa oothis; ba aawanne ba aaye ogiyaninne Isra7eele asa nagara oosisida, Nabaaxa na7aa Iyorbaama ogiyan hemetis.
Akaziyaasi Ba7aale eeqas oothis; iya goyinnis. Iya aaway kase oothidaysada, Godaa Isra7eele Xoossaa hanqethis.
